title: Compact SDK Quickstart: modular overlay visuals for ephemeral-key streaming + tool orchestration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, modular visual set for the API/SDK quickstart that focuses on ephemeral (short-lived) API keys, streaming responses, and a minimal tool-calling example. Deliverables should be reusable across the docs site and embeddable in the SDK quickstart pane and release notes. Aim for assets that read clearly at small sizes used in docs sidebars and larger hero placements for the onboarding page. Assets to produce: 1) Eight micro-illustrations (auth flows, ephemeral key exchange, streaming handshake, KV cache hint, tool-call success/error), 2) Three composite screenshots showing annotated SDK snippets + live streaming terminal, 3) Two animated GIF flows (device-code ephemeral key and streaming partial response), 4) Four overlay cards with code snippet + one-line explainer for embeddable docs components. Work with Docs and Eng to ensure examples use the current API surface and do not imply unreleased features. Prioritize clarity and small file size (SVG + optimized GIF). Include accessible alt copy for every image and provide a text-only fallback for the animated GIFs.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 micro-illustrations exported as SVG + 2x/3x PNG fallbacks
3 composite screenshots produced using verified SDK snippets from docs repo (see links) and approved by Eng
2 GIF flows under 1.5MB each after optimization and with accompanying text transcripts
4 overlay code cards delivered as component-ready SVGs and a Figma variant with auto-layout frames
Design sign-off from PM (Maya Chen) and technical review from Eng (ticket ENG-3028 referenced)
Assets uploaded to Drive + referenced in docs PR; alt text and captions provided for each asset
